pages.text: Stainless steel reinforced sealed bricks, doors, and trapdoors are reinforced cold-storage materials. They use FirmaLife structure detection and provide a -30°C structure limit for stainless steel reinforced cold storage.

pages.title: Reinforcement Recipes
pages.text: Reinforced sealed bricks use stainless steel sheets, sealed bricks, and any hammer to produce 4 blocks. Reinforced sealed doors use a stainless steel sheet, a sealed door, and any hammer to produce 1 door. Reinforced sealed trapdoors use a stainless steel sheet, a sealed trapdoor, and any hammer to produce 2 trapdoors. The hammer only loses durability.
Recipe for stainless steel reinforced sealed bricks.

Cold-storage walls can mix sealed bricks and stainless steel reinforced sealed bricks. Mixed structures calculate the minimum temperature as a weighted average based on the two thermal wall counts, and use the power tier of the more common material; ties use the higher-cost tier.
